overview: 研究需要区分细胞进入、急性临床疾病和感染后长期影响。某个宿主因子参与进入，并不意味着检测到其表达就能预测个体症状、组织感染或药物疗效。

Research spans cellular entry, acute disease and post-infection effects. Participation of a host factor does not mean that its expression alone predicts individual symptoms, tissue infection or clinical drug efficacy.
established: Hoffmann等2020年细胞研究支持ACE2的受体作用及TMPRSS2的蛋白酶作用。它是机制证据，不是证明相关抑制剂能改善患者结局的临床试验。疫苗和适用患者的早期抗病毒治疗已有临床应用。

Hoffmann and colleagues (2020) provide cellular evidence for ACE2 as a receptor and TMPRSS2 as a host protease. This is mechanistic evidence, not a clinical trial proving patient benefit from inhibiting either factor. Vaccination and early antiviral care for eligible patients have clinical roles.
uncertainties: 长新冠包含不同临床表现；单一机制难以解释所有患者。不同免疫背景、再感染和随访时间会影响研究结果的可比性。
Long COVID encompasses heterogeneous presentations. No single explanation establishes causation for every patient; immunity, reinfection and follow-up duration affect comparability.
priorities: 优先采用清晰分型和可重复结局评价长新冠干预，研究高风险人群的持久保护，并评估现有防治措施在实际医疗中的可及性。
Prioritize reproducible long-COVID subgroups and outcomes, durable protection in vulnerable groups, and real-world access to prevention and care.

ACE2 is a principal entry receptor for SARS-CoV-2; TMPRSS2 is a host protease involved in entry, not a receptor. Hoffmann et al. (2020) support this distinction; expression of one host factor alone does not predict clinical infection or severe disease.
mechanism: 呼吸道感染及宿主炎症反应共同参与疾病；细胞进入机制、急性器官损伤和长新冠需要分层讨论，不能由单个受体解释全部病程。

Respiratory infection and host inflammation contribute to disease. Cellular entry, acute organ injury and long COVID require separate consideration; no single receptor explains the entire clinical course.
progress: 基础研究已明确ACE2受体与TMPRSS2蛋白酶的不同角色；疫苗和适用人群抗病毒治疗具有临床应用。长新冠的异质性与持久保护仍是研究重点，机制发现不等于临床药物有效。

Foundational research distinguishes the ACE2 receptor from the TMPRSS2 protease. Vaccines and antivirals for eligible patients have clinical roles. Heterogeneous long COVID and durable protection remain research priorities; mechanistic findings alone do not prove clinical efficacy.

overview: 流感A与B不能视为临床和免疫学上完全相同的对象。季节性疾病负担取决于流行病毒、人群既往免疫与年龄结构，因此单个季节的研究结论未必适用于下一季。

Influenza A and B are not clinically or immunologically interchangeable. Seasonal burden depends on circulating viruses, prior immunity and age structure, so findings from one season may not transfer directly to the next.
established: 年度疫苗与适时抗病毒治疗是成熟防治工具。观察性疫苗有效性研究应区分感染、门诊就诊、住院及死亡等终点。

Annual vaccination and timely antiviral care are established tools. Observational effectiveness studies should distinguish infection, outpatient illness, hospitalization and death rather than treating them as one endpoint.
uncertainties: 保护持续时间、老年人免疫反应和不同季节之间的有效性差异仍需持续评价。研究性广谱疫苗不能与已获批常规疫苗等同。
Protection duration, responses in older adults and season-to-season effectiveness need continuing evaluation. Investigational broader vaccines are not equivalent to licensed routine products.
priorities: 比较不同人群的临床保护持续性，改进快速诊断与治疗衔接，并检验接种策略能否减少住院而不仅提高抗体水平。

Compare durable clinical protection across populations, improve diagnostic-to-treatment linkage, and test whether vaccination strategies reduce hospitalization rather than merely raise antibody levels.

RSV research focuses on severe lower-respiratory disease early and late in life. Maternal vaccination, infant long-acting antibodies and older-adult vaccines target different populations; evidence for one product cannot simply substitute for another.

priorities: 开展长期真实世界效果与安全监测，比较可行的母婴保护策略，并将资源有限地区的住院和死亡结局纳入评价。
Prioritize long-term effectiveness and safety surveillance, feasible maternal–infant strategies, and hospitalization and mortality outcomes in resource-limited settings.

Improve vaccination and screening access, evaluate simplified service delivery, and distinguish investigational therapeutic vaccines from established prophylactic vaccination.

established: 疫苗、安全饮水和食品卫生是成熟措施。重症风险与年龄及基础肝病背景有关；补液和肝功能支持不同于特异性抗病毒治疗。

Combine seroepidemiology and outbreak investigation to improve vaccine delivery, adult immunity gaps, mobile populations and timely contact management.

Finding undiagnosed infections, retaining patients in care and preventing reinfection often determine public-health impact more than demonstrating antiviral activity again.
priorities: 优先研究简化检测、社区治疗与风险人群服务，并长期评估治愈后的肝癌风险及疫苗候选的临床价值。

Immunity duration, correlates of protection and breadth of candidate vaccines against clinical disease require prospective assessment.

Prioritize sensitive surveillance, vaccination of underserved populations, long-term rehabilitation and implementation strategies that sustain elimination.

WHO’s cited 2025 guidance limits specified candidate antivirals to research settings; routine care remains supportive. Jaundice and organ dysfunction indicate severe illness.
uncertainties: 如何及早识别进展至重症者、改善器官支持及评价罕见不良事件，需要超过单个病例报告的证据。
Earlier recognition of progression, better organ support and assessment of rare adverse events require evidence beyond individual case reports.
priorities: 重点填补接种空白、优化暴发应对与转诊，使用明确的临床终点评价研究性治疗，并加强特殊人群的风险收益研究。
Close vaccination gaps, improve outbreak response and referral, evaluate investigational therapy with clinical endpoints, and study benefits and risks in special populations.
